say:4:1010123002:0.text: I came all this way for you, Valen! And you're asking me to work for someone from Southville? For free?!

say:5:1010123003:0.text: Look how shabby he looks. I don't need him or this stupid bridge! I don't need to go back today!
say:5:1010123003:0.source_cn: 一副穷酸相，谁稀罕你们北村修的破桥。大不了，这个家我今...

say:8:1010123004:0.text: Hey! C'mon, Gramps! Did you forget your wife is waiting for you at home?!
say:8:1010123004:0.source_cn: 哇哇哇，老人家，别忘记你还有个等着吃药的太太呀！

say:9:1010123005:0.text: Well, she gets sick so often because you Northville fools. You're just so aggravating!

say:18:1010123010:0.text: There's no point in arguing, Gramps. Here, eat something.
say:18:1010123010:0.source_cn: 老爷爷，先别吵了，吃点东西吧。

say:19:1010123011:0.text: I'm not hungry! I'm too angry right now!

say:22:1010123012:0.text: This area has been picked clean by monsters. What did you find to eat?
say:22:1010123012:0.source_cn: 这附近都被怪物糟蹋完了，能找到什么吃的？

say:25:1010123013:0.text: We found some fresh glowfly fruit. We'd be happy to share some with you.
say:25:1010123013:0.source_cn: 我们刚刚采来了新鲜的萤瓤果，如果不介意的话，也分给你一些吧？

say:27:1010123015:0.text: I know it's a bit cheeky, but could I have all the fruit? I left in such a hurry that I didn't bring any money out.
say:27:1010123015:0.source_cn: 我有个不情之请。你们的萤瓤果，能全部给我吗？但我走得仓...

say:28:1010123016:0.text: Valen told me you all wanted to go to Southville. How about a trade? Glowfly fruit for bridge repairs?
say:28:1010123016:0.source_cn: 维伦跟我说你们要去南村，作为交换，我帮你们修好这座桥吧？

choice_prompt:29:1010123016.text: Valen told me you all wanted to go to Southville. How about a trade? Glowfly fruit for bridge repairs?
choice_prompt:29:1010123016.source_cn: 维伦跟我说你们要去南村，作为交换，我帮你们修好这座桥吧？

say:30:1010123017:0.text:
Here you go.
I already ate one. They're really sweet!
say:30:1010123017:0.source_cn: 来，拿好这些果子。\n我刚才偷偷尝了一个，真的很甜呢！

say:31:1010123019:0.text: Say hi to Sasha for me.

say:32:1010123020:0.text:
You... So this is what you meant when you said there'd be something in it for me...
But I'll still thank you on my daughter's behalf.
say:32:1010123020:0.source_cn: 你这小子，说能给我好处，就是这个意思……\n还是替我女...

say:33:1010123021:0.text: She loves glowfly fruit, but it's been hard to find them with all the monsters around. She's been a little down since she hadn't had one in a while...
say:33:1010123021:0.source_cn: 她最爱吃的东西就是萤瓤果，但最近这里多了很多怪物，很难...

say:34:1010123022:0.text: Really? When I saw her just now, her smile was just as bright as the first day we met.
say:34:1010123022:0.source_cn: 是吗？刚刚看见她，感觉她的笑容还是像初见那天那样明媚。

say:35:1010123023:0.source_cn: 那是因为她看见你了吧……

say:36:1010123024:0.text: I think it's probably because she knew that something good was about to come her way.
say:36:1010123024:0.source_cn: 我倒觉得，或许是因为她预感到了马上要降临的好运。

say:39:1010123025:0.text: Hey! Let's all chat later. Maybe fix the bridge first.
say:39:1010123025:0.source_cn: 大家！闲聊以后再说，要不然我们还是先把桥修好吧？

narration:40:1010123026:0.text: A while later, the bridge lever was fixed.
narration:40:1010123026:0.source_cn: 一段时间后，桥的机关被修好了

say:43:1010123027:0.text: Ahem... It's also time for me to bring something good to my wife.
say:43:1010123027:0.source_cn: 咳……我也是时候将好运带给家人了。

say:44:1010123028:0.text: I apologize for my words earlier, my northern friend.
say:44:1010123028:0.source_cn: 我为自己的言行道歉，北村人。

say:45:1010123029:0.text: Yeah, it's fine. You should head back. Her condition won't cure itself.
say:45:1010123029:0.source_cn: 唔。没事。你快回去吧，耽误了病情就不好了。
